reviews.text: Shape of Dreams: Prologue is a really exciting, beautifully made dream, weaving in the difficulty and challenges I love in a roguelike, with elements similar to Gunfire Reborn, Risk of Rain, and Hades. While this is just a prologue, I enjoyed it quite a bit, and will continue to play more of it and offer feedback until its official release later on. Overall a fun addition to the roguelike family, and a fun demo of what's there to come in the future. Some pros and cons of what I think so far: [b][u]PROS:[/u][/b] +Game is visually stunning, and makes no sacrifices in gameplay while looking gorgeous, bonus with a great music vibe as well +Co-op is fun, not entirely seamless, but when it works, it's a blast with others +Character designs and lore are interesting, and unique, even the artifacts you find later have a good bit of detailed lore about the game +Currently the major 3 stat skill trees are shared across your characters, with the last one being the character's own unique one +Prologue feels solid for a demo, a lot offered to play and feel around for hours, and progress saved will be transferred apparently [b][u]CONS:[/u][/b] -FPS kinda tanks when there's at least a full lobby and depending on your PC, can look like a slideshow with too many effects, but easily tweaked in settings for now until better optimization options and fixes are added -Some of the map node spawns feel a bit redundant and serve no purpose, ex: having no money to spend early and 2 merchants right after spawn, or 500 gold/dream dust with no merchants nor wells to upgrade, can probably be fixed later on prior to release -At the current state, melee vs ranged feels a bit tipping on the scales, as some bosses feel unforgiving towards melee classes until you get better stat/memory upgrades in the trees, or good RNG on memories and essences -Currently the skill trees feel a bit grindy to get some upgrades in the trees, so it being expensive as the actual currency used: stardust, is a bit hard to obtain aside from defeating bosses, also doesn't help that some crucial/more desirable traits are further up in the trees as well, making it feel more of an inconvenience

And one of us has experienced zero issues... but with 24 cores... I digress.

What a fantastic demo! Found it by looking through the trending free tab on steam and it's been an absolute blast. As a keyboard and mouse player, the option for either WSAD movement or the classic MOBA style (my preference) really shows the developers consideration for the player and their experience. Certainly starts off as a challenge until you get the hang of the mechanics. I've found myself 'maining' the unlockable 5th character. Solo'd my way through all three levels with a really nice sustain and auto attach reset build. Multiplayer was initially a challenge (OCE player), but I've found a reasonable amount of success finding people to play with when I am hosting, removing any lag issues. Very keen to see the upgrade trees for the characters to come through, until then I'll be saving up my stardust. Definite recommendation for those who are looking for a little side project to sink some time into. Well done!

[h3]预感将成为继Hades第一作之后的又一俯视角动作肉鸽黑马，更不用说在游戏性方面秒了Ravenswatch、Wizard of Legend 2等一票近百元无聊的同类型肉鸽不知道多少条街了 [/h3] 通了几次关，总体在我的必买榜上，反馈给制作组些改进建议： 1.敌我数值成长可以再平滑些。现在一局游戏到第二次轮回中后期就已经是互相秒了，建议调整BOSS攻击频速、减少双方伤害或者增加双方血量（不过感觉也可能是制作组还没放出后续BOSS，导致难度曲线从10%、20%递进直接跳到二周目的100%了）。 2.降低肝度。局外加点太地狱了，回忆起了哈迪斯几十个小时解锁不到一半只好开修改器的恐惧，建议控制在通关3次左右就可以完全解锁一个角色，不要本末倒置了，这方面可以学下暖雪。 3.增加词典或更详细的面板。因为这个游戏宝石技能之间联动很多，还有不少新造词，导致有些时候不清楚特效是否适用到了技能上（比如有技能将第一次伤害视为一次“攻击”，制作组倒是很有心的把关键词高亮了，但我还是不确定增加普攻的宝石是否产生了影响；再比如给充能技附加冷却时间缩短、给治疗技附加伤害等等，光看面板都无法确定）。建议把每个形成联动的关键词都解释一下（比如鼠标移上去自动出现补充说明），或者增加演武场稻草人让玩家自己去试。 4.丰富技能升级树。目前技能升个八九级也只是数值上递增，有点1-60级装备打1-60级小龙虾的感觉，正反馈越来越少，建议可以每5级增加一个大提升的三选一：加一次充能、冷却减半、略微增加真实伤害或免疫等等。以及击败BOSS给的一次免费升级，要让我看一下各技能宝石花钱升级的价格才好选择啊。 5.改进经济系统。因为钱可以转化为升级用的结晶，所以本质上是钱的来源优化问题，而钱目前只能是靠杀怪、卖东西、献祭来获得。建议一是多元渠道，比如做任务、砸罐子、投资理财等；二是平衡增长速度，我顶着猎人把全部节点都走一遍，后期还是只能买得起一两个商品；三是平衡诅咒收益，目前我点了最强诅咒debuff的局都瞬间去世了，导致现在只敢拿最低档的钱。 其他增加多种元素伤害、剧情、NPC、遗物藏品这些就不说了，且看正式版如何，相信并期待！

Really cool roguelike. It has essences, which are modifiers you can apply to any ability, making many abilities compatible with your build which otherwise would be quite useless. And this essences can be swapped at any moment. Really fun as it makes each run a unique style. Even the class abilities can be changed by other "regular" abilities that you pick on the way. Only one ability cannot be changed, which is the only passive one that gives that class its identity, making each class having a distinct playstyle, Also, the game is a mix between a demo and early access. But so far I didn't find any bugs and the core gameplay loop is strong. TL;DR if you like roguelikes, then download it and play it. Nothing to lose but time. And most likely it's worth your time.

优秀的皮囊，差劲的游戏设计，游戏玩法在类暗黑玩build割草与肉鸽闯关之间模糊不清，具体表现为游戏内存在大量自定义项，但是自定义项的获取受限，自定义项间联动也很匮乏。 本游戏一名玩家有20格槽位，四个技能一个被动，每个技能和被动各有三个宝石插槽，出门角色携带三个天生技能一个被动，技能可更换被动不可更换，除了技能宝石获取是随机掉落之外其他的随机性也就是加成三选一选项随机、地图随机、路线惩罚随机，已经可以看出来本游戏就没什么肉鸽要素了，实际游玩过程就是搜自己要的build然后闯关，在提升来源的限制下基本上就是单技能+被动+几颗关键宝石打到底，而且由于提升手段只有货币买数值，导致还涉及到一个问题：这么多升级项你买那个，比起对比技能间提升差异，算升级提升效率其实是一件很没意思的事。 然后就是build玩法的问题，技能宝石获取除了关卡掉落（一次一个）和boss奖励最大的来源就是商店购买（三宝石三技能），上述来源获取在当前池子深度下池子已经很深了，要知道现在还是测试阶段后续还会继续填加内容，从build角度来讲本游戏的技能池与宝石反倒没有那么深，而且技能与宝石间的绑定情况比较严重，可以说本游戏的build玩法体验也不那么舒服，当然本游戏有个特性是联机情况下玩家独立掉落，也就是说有几个玩家产出就翻几倍，但是产出优化并不能优化build玩法本身的体验。 综上所述，本游戏在好看的皮囊下面其实是一塌糊涂的游戏体验，肉鸽与build两大玩法都没形成有效的游戏体验，上文其实还没提到本游戏大量的突脸与闪避CD之间的冲突、近战与远程之间强度差距巨大等小问题，只能说基础没打好上面的一切都是无根浮萍，这个基础能不能有所改善我本人是持悲观态度的。

Great game, lots of potential However I find one element to be much too frustrating. There's an enemy attack, which puts a bunch of rings on the ground and then rains either 1 huge or a ton of small meteors at you. Getting hit by the big one is bascially an instant gameover, you have little time to react and it takes 90% of your health, stuns you for a couple seconds, enough time to get hit by all the small meteors, or another big one, without being able to act. Ever played RoR2? Having basically become a god and suddenly instantly dying without knowing what happened? It feels awful and this gives exactly the same bad feeling. This wouldn't be a huge problem, if it wasn't so incredibly frequent (you can be surrounded by 3 big meteors at once, while covered in, like, 40 small ones) and nearly impossible to move out of if you don't have multiple dodges ready, and once you've used all your dodges, there's another 3 big and 40 small onces coming at you, and your dodges haven't recharged, it's seemingly cast by enemies that haven't even spawned yet too. A large majority of the gameplay is simply trying to dodge these meteors. And this is on the easiest difficulty and before being even halfway to the first boss. (It's even worse on higher difficulty of course) In my opinion this requires balancing (which is easy, simply give more time to react or reduce the ridiculous frequency of these attacks or remove the stun or reduce the damage or make the circle smaller) since, so far, this attack is the only real threat, while all other enemies are practically harmless and easily dealt with. Cannot recommend the game atm simply due to this one attack.
